why: an armed pair a young colony past RCL2 cannot answer (no tower, its Defend unanswered) fires the safe mode RCL2 granted: its insurance until the tower stands, which expand-claims-a-neighbour bounds within the safe mode's 20000 ticks. Main fires it too (Defend's last resort); a lone 1-ATTACK raider the colony answers in 160 ticks spends nothing. A scripted raider, since only its being armed and unanswered in the young room is read. The raid stands one tile inside W7N3 (`inside`): stood on its exit it bounced into W6N3, and a harvester of ours passing there held it off the young room (claimSafeMode 0 on a change that only moved that harvester's timing)
